svg.title: The nine safety goals
svg.desc: Nine small scenes of the robotaxi, one per safety goal of WP-C-03, each with its ASIL and safe state. SG-01, ASIL D: Avoid unintended acceleration. SG-02, ASIL D: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids. SG-03, ASIL C: Avoid unintended hard deceleration. SG-04, ASIL D: Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path. SG-05, ASIL D: Avoid unintended motion from standstill, forward or backward. SG-06, ASIL D: Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way. SG-07, ASIL D: Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely. SG-08, ASIL C: Do not act on remote driving commands that are stale, corrupted or not the operator's. SG-09, ASIL C: Avoid signalling a manoeuvre other than the one performed.
